description: Hand-written passages for scoring the local drainage-deficit classifier. SYNTHETIC: written by Team A in the style of Kenyan news and humanitarian reports; not quotes from real reports. Labels: drainage = flooding blamed on drains, culverts, sewers or water with nowhere to go (drainage or surface-runoff mechanism); river = a river or stream overflowing; other = no flood mechanism (weather forecasts, flood mention without cause, unrelated news). The dev split sets thresholds; the test split is scored once afterwards and never used for tuning.
